policy.adjustment: Holm adjustment across the two planned tests

score_difference_by_mri.null: The mean score difference between the MRI groups is zero

thickness_by_status.null: All four mean thicknesses are equal
thickness_by_status.alternative: At least one mean thickness differs

interpretation.familywise_error: Holm controls the familywise error rate under valid raw p-values, including dependent tests.
interpretation.confidence_intervals: Reported 95% intervals are individual intervals; the Holm adjustment applies to the two test p-values.
interpretation.p_value: Under the null hypothesis and test assumptions, the probability of a test statistic at least as incompatible with the null as the observed statistic.
interpretation.omnibus: Rejection supports a difference in at least one population mean under the model assumptions. It does not identify a particular pair of groups.
